title: Martin vs go-pmtiles vs tileserver-gl vs mbtileserver vs BBOX
deck: Five open-source tile servers serving one pre-built vector tile archive of Berlin, as MBTiles and as PMTiles, with identical tiles in both: single-tile latency at four zoom levels, throughput at 10 and 100 clients, a random tile walk over 256 tiles, four-tile viewport bursts, cold start and memory.
trademarks: Martin is a project of the MapLibre organization.
go-pmtiles and the PMTiles format are developed by Protomaps.
mbtileserver is developed by the Conservation Biology Institute.
Planetiler is developed by Michael Barry and contributors; the tile schema is OpenMapTiles.
Map data: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, via the Geofabrik Berlin extract of 2026-01-01; water polygons from OSMData, Natural Earth public domain.
